entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metal world of the Scars of Mirrodin set, home to leonin, loxodon, myr and five color-aligned human tribes.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: A necromancer-like figure whose lair is Ish Sah in the Mephidross.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: A region of Mirrodin where nim lurk among the necrogen mists.

entities.name: Tel-Jilad
entities.description: The coppery jungle region of Mirrodin around the Tree of Tales, defended by elves and trolls.

entities.name: Tree of Tales
entities.description: The greatest tree of Mirrodin's coppery jungles, with lore etched into its surfaces.

entities.name: Skithiryx
entities.description: A Phyrexianized dragon known as the Blight Dragon.

entities.name: Nim
entities.description: Undead creatures that lurk among the necrogen mists of the Mephidross.

entities.name: Soliton
entities.description: An artifact creature that is an independent half of a Gemini Engine.

entities.name: Gemini Engine
entities.description: A machine of which Soliton is one independent half.

entities.name: Ezuri
entities.description: An elvish leader dedicated to crushing unnatural artifacts to restore the primacy of nature.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: A civilization inside the Multiverse that launched one of its most destructive invasions.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Originally a medical doctor who chose to create plagues and poisons and led Phyrexia in a destructive invasion.

entities.name: Praetors
entities.description: Phyrexians of high rank and great power.

events.summary: Yawgmoth, once a medical doctor, chooses to use his brilliance to create plagues and poisons.
events.quote: Instead he chose to use his brilliance to create plagues and poisons

events.summary: Yawgmoth leads Phyrexia in a murderous invasion of the Multiverse.
events.quote: ultimately leading Phyrexia in one of the most destructive, murderous invasions the Multiverse has ever known

relations.note: Ish Sah is Geth's lair in the Mephidross.
